name: Minnesota
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Minnesota's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward), including the Northwest Angle, which sets the north edge at 49.39. The east edge is Grand Portage on Lake Superior; open lake beyond it is trimmed. The box takes in parts of Ontario, Manitoba, the Dakotas, Iowa and Wisconsin, and the Lake Superior shoreline inside it. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-mn.
